title: FR: Offline audio downloads directly from the library
summary: ### What problem would this feature solve? Downloading offline audio for multiple books is tedious because you currently have to open each book individually to trigger the download. ### Describe the solution you'd like. Add a "Download Audio" button or context menu option directly in the main libraryview. ### Describe workarounds you may have used to acheive the same results. Manually opening every book one by one, starting the TTS engine, then the download, and leaving the book open to ensure it's done before moving to the next title. ### Additional Context _No response_
